steps.title: Prepare PCR control set
steps.instruction: Assemble the required PCR controls as follows: use pre‑assembled 16S R1 and R2 primers; for ITS, use R1 and R2 without primers and tags removed; include the following controls – NC (negative control), Taer (aerosol control), Tex (extraction blank), Tpcr (PCR control), and PC (positive DNA control).

substeps.instruction: Use the already assembled 16S R1 and R2 primers.
For ITS, use R1 and R2 without primers and with tags removed.
Add NC as the negative control.
Add Taer as the aerosol control.
Add Tex as the blank extraction control.
Add Tpcr as the PCR control.
Add PC as the positive DNA control.
